Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 5
Attendance
Employees record their attendance in the HR portal every working day, whether they work from
the office or from home.
Marking attendance
Mark yourself present by 10:30 am. If you forget, you can correct your attendance within 3
working days, and your manager must approve the correction.
Late arrival
Core hours are 10 am to 4 pm. Arriving after 10:30 am three times in one month counts as half
a day of casual leave.
Absence without leave
If you are absent without applying for leave or telling your manager, the day is treated as
unpaid leave. Absence without notice for 3 days in a row is a serious breach of policy.
Attendance reports
Managers receive a monthly attendance report for their team on the 2nd of every month and
must check it within 5 working days.
